description: This file defines a class called MicCaptureManager that manages microphone capture, speech recognition, and interaction with a voice assistant, including handling recognition events, managing conversation state, and communication with a gateway.

classes.name: VoiceConversationRole
classes.description: An enum indicating whether a conversation entry is from the user or the assistant.

classes.name: VoiceConversationEntry
classes.description: A data class representing a single exchange in the conversation, with an ID, role, text, and streaming status.

classes.name: MicCaptureManager
classes.description: A class managing microphone input, speech recognition, and communication with a voice processing gateway, handling recognition events and conversation state.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the microphone, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: pauseForTts
methods.description: Pauses recognition to allow TTS output to be spoken without interference.

methods.name: resumeAfterTts
methods.description: Resumes recognition after TTS output has completed.

methods.name: onGatewayConnectionChanged
methods.description: Updates the internal state based on the connection status of the gateway.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming events from the gateway, updating the recognition or conversation state accordingly.
